title: Wolt's Delivery Talent: Grow's Rapid Ramp-Up - (Grow)

facts.fact: Grow reports it generated 22+ offers for Wolt within 5 months, with a 77% offer acceptance rate.
facts.quote: Generated 22+ offers within 5 months with 77% acceptance rate.

facts.fact: Grow reports it helped Wolt's TA team grow by 150% within 4 months.
